text: And now, finally, God answered Job from the eye of a violent storm. He said:
Why do you talk without knowing what you're talking about?
Up on your feet! Stand tall! I have some questions for you, and I want some straight answers.
Tell me, since you know so much!
Who came up with the blueprints and measurements?
and who set the cornerstone,
and all the angels shouted praise?
when it gushed forth like a baby from the womb?
and tucked it in safely at night.

they're caught in the very act!

Do you have one clue regarding death's dark mysteries?
Speak up if you have even the beginning of an answer.

You've known them all your life, grown up in the same neighborhood with them!

And who do you think is the father of rain and dew,
the mother of ice and frost?
these marvels of weather just happen, do you?
or distract Orion from his hunt?
or get the Great Bear and her cubs to come out and play?
and how they affect things on Earth?
and commission a shower of rain?
and have them report to you for orders?
and storm-savvy to the rooster?
or tip over the rain barrels of heaven
the ground baked hard as a brick?
and satisfy the appetite of her cubs
waiting hungrily in their cave?
when their young cry to God, fluttering about because they have no food?
